attchmntText: Manoj Vaibhav Gems N Jewellers Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
sm_name: Manoj Vaibhav Gems N Jewellers Limited
voiceSummary: Manoj Vaibhav Gems N Jewellers Limited approved un-audited financial results for the half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of 150460 Crores and a profit after tax of 6327 Crores for the period. Basic earnings per share stood at 1295. The Board also approved the revision of Related Party Transaction limits with M/s. Gontla Trading LLP for the Financial Year 2026–27. The aggregate limit was increased from 200 Crores to 274 Crores. This transaction qualifies as a Related Party Transaction under Section 188 of the Companies Act, 2013. The revised limits cover the sale and purchase of bullion and jewellery.
